D.authoritative: Only attributable governed/reference inputs are authoritative.
D.requiredForRelease: Only artifacts named by the current evidence manifest are release-required.

E.reproducible: Release manifests and automated checks are reproducible; browser screenshots are captured validation artifacts.
E.authoritative: Evidence is authoritative only when bound to this releaseId and codeStateHash.
E.requiredForRelease: Current manifest, running certifications, and their exact referenced evidence only.
E.redundant: Superseded release artifacts are not part of the proposed staged set.
E.machineLocalRuntimeState: Runtime databases, logs, PIDs, caches, and temporary browser profiles are excluded as group F.
E.decision: Stage only exact current-release evidence after all gates pass.

policy: Never use git add .; group F must never be committed.
